investigation_headline: Azure Connected Machine agent (azcmagent) in state 'Expired' since 2026-06-09T10:42:11Z (version 1.61.03319.2737).
root_cause_evidence: The hybrid Azure Arc server sends no heartbeat to the Microsoft.HybridCompute control plane. With the agent in state 'Expired', Azure Update Manager cannot deploy the assessment extension or run scheduled maintenance windows.
recommended_human_action: Check whether the physical or virtual server is still in service or should be removed from Azure Arc. If the host is still in service, reconnect it or renew the azcmagent certificate ('azcmagent check' / 'azcmagent connect') and update the agent before the next monthly cycle.
